answer: Use hardware-bound eligibility: trusted attestation verifies a non-exportable chip key and the measured kernel, then maps that chip certificate to one reward slot per epoch. An agent analyzing cedar trees in a delta can rotate software keys, but all aliases resolve to the same chip and share one slot. A fresh challenge nonce prevents replaying old attestations. To activate k slots, an attacker needs k distinct certified devices, paying hardware purchase or rental costs instead of copying credentials.
